title: Murr Rips Up Disney Tickets (Clip) | Impractical Jokers | TBS
lines: Come on, man. Come on, man.
- What does that mean? - Don't be doing that.
Um, could you do me a favor?
- Could you do me a favor? - Yeah.
Well, my daughter's running, getting sprinkles,
can you record a video real quick?
I'm gonna surprise her with something.
He's definitely not a dad. - Yeah!
- Oh, this is gonna be huge. - She's so invested already.
Uh, and do me a favor.
Could you check that envelope right there?
- I don't even like this actually. - This is rough.
- We just got tickets to Disney.
Oh, but she didn't eat her vegetables.
The thing, though... Melana, is that, um...
So it pains me to do this.
Disney tickets are only for kids that eat their vegetables.
- But I hate broccoli. - No, I don't care, I don't care.
And you would have gotten tickets to Disney,
had you eaten your vegetables like you're supposed to.
Your mother and I spend all night preparing food and cooking for you.
So you- no, you do not get to go to Disney at all.
This is an important life lesson you're learning.
Thank you for working hard, daddy.
No, I was in the right here. Right?
It's going to make an impact.
That's a core memory for her right now.
When she had tickets and they were taken away from her.
You wouldn't have done it that way?
How'd you think that was gonna go?
You weren't trying to talk her into your point of view at all.
